name: ScrapingBee
tagline: Headless browser scrape API for HTML extraction and anti-bot bypass.
description: ScrapingBee is a web scraping API that renders pages with headless browsers, handles proxies and CAPTCHAs, and returns HTML or extracted data so developers can scrape sites without running their own browser infrastructure.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (self-serve signup at app.scrapingbee.com).
